relations.note: Ein Sof’s ray forms or fills Adam Kadmon after tzimtzum.
The ten powers are ordered in, represented by, or emanated through Adam Kadmon.
Earthly Adam is the lower created image or reflection of Adam Kadmon.
Shekhinah or Malkhut occupies the receptive lowest position within the supernal structure.

Christian Cabalists interpreted Adam Kadmon as the preexistent Christ or Logos.
Modern scholars compare both as heavenly human archetypes; their primary sources never identify or unite them.
Modern comparison links their cosmic-human imagery, despite different narratives, functions, and no historical identification.
Blake’s universal human is compared structurally with Adam Kadmon, though direct dependence remains debated.
Theosophical writers correlated Adam Kadmon with Brahmā within a universalized occult system.
Theosophy correlated Adam Kadmon with Puruṣa; medieval Kabbalah does not support this identity.
Marvel’s cosmic personification Eternity has used Adam Qadmon as an alias.
